english.title: Sex offender fail to notify name etc to police subsequent to registration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed without reasonable excuse to comply with section 2(2) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997 in that, before the end of 14 days beginning with

(A)_[your using a name which had not been notified to the police,]_
(B)_[a change in your home address,]_
(C)_[your having resided or stayed for a period of 14 days or two or more periods amounting to 14 days in 12 months at an address in the United Kingdom which had not been notified to the police,]_

you did not notify the police of

(D)_[that name, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_
(E)_[the change in your home address, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_
(F)_[the address of those premises, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_
(G)_[your date of birth, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_
(H)_[your name, namely **(..SPECIFY..) used by you on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..)]_
(I)_[each of the names, namely **(..SPECIFY..) used by you on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..)]_
(J)_[your home address, namely **(..SPECIFY..) on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1)(a) and (1A) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - Now see offence wording CJS Code SX03204 - H5862 or CJS Code SX03205 -H5863

(i) The offence starts on the first day of failure to comply and continues throughout any period of failure.
(ii) Offender will only be prosecuted once for the same failure (section 3(2)).
(iii) See Section 2(7) for meaning of "home address" and Section 1(8) for "relevant date"
(iv) As amended by Schedule 5 to the Criminal Justice and Court Services Act 2000
(v) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum. Where the offender is under the age of eighteen years - a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale. (section 4(4)).
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
